en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a beautifully landscaped garden with neatly trimmed bushes, benches, palm trees, and a decorative fence. There is an ornate garden structure at the center, with lush vegetation surrounding the scene. The reverse side contains handwritten text in German, a green stamp with a man's profile, a postmark from 'BAD PYRMONT,' and a blue stamp reading 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT.' The printed text on the image's front reads, 'Bad Pyrmont Palmengarten Verlobungslaube'.
